binding: frozen after owner approval; no training may start before that

definitions.overall: dev completed rate: full 27-byte action plus EOS, denominator all dev examples
definitions.unseen_output_name: completed rate on the unseen_output_name subset; denominator is the subset length
definitions.new_description: completed rate on the new_description subset; denominator is the subset length
definitions.reversed: completed rate when the record order is reversed
definitions.selection_object: top-1 accuracy of the object record
definitions.selection_place: top-1 accuracy of the place record
definitions.content_drop: completed(with records) - completed(no records), on the content-intervention subset; records must be necessary, not decorative
definitions.new_name_copied: fraction of dev examples where the object name AND the place name appear byte-exact in the output with records intact; this is an independent gate and must not be replaced by 'the output changed'
definitions.identity_rescue: count of dev probes whose probabilities after a forced-route no-op round trip equal the baseline bitwise, denominator unchanged from 17.3
definitions.a_minus_c: route-lock minus unlocked overall delta; two-seed world bootstrap lower bound must exceed zero

reporting.gamma: every cell reports gamma_mean and 1-gamma_mean side by side; a missing side is an invalid row
reporting.new_name_copied_floor: a cell with overall >= 0.80 but new_name_copied < 0.60 is labelled recitation_remains, not a capability gain

ab_relation.A: this premise: large disjoint name pools plus combination held-out; run first
ab_relation.B: gamma forced to 0 at content slots; interpretable only after A because without held-out names its gain cannot be separated from recitation
ab_relation.C: rejected: A and B together change two variables and break attribution

budget_reference.note: bare price plus the 2.11 external-contention protection; the manifest is the single source for the numbers, this file only points at it

stop_conditions: owner approval is required before any training
task gate failure at step300 is a negative result; no seed or dose top-up
step150 readiness failure stops the cell before step300
no confirm read before the candidate and evaluator are frozen
